versos.grego: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος, οὐκ ἀπ’ ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν,

controles.web: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
controles.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
controles.livre: Paulo, apóstolo (não da parte dos seres humanos, nem por meio de homem algum, mas sim por Jesus Cristo, e por Deus Pai, que o ressuscitou dos mortos),

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ πάντες ἀδελφοί, ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας·

controles.web: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
controles.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
controles.livre: e todos os irmãos que estão comigo, para as igrejas da Galácia.

versos.grego: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
controles.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
controles.livre: Graça seja convosco, e também a paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo,

versos.grego: τοῦ δόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν, ὅπως ἐξέληται ἡμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος πονηροῦ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν,

controles.web: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
controles.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
controles.livre: que deu a si mesmo pelos nossos pecados, para nos tirar da presente era maligna, conforme a vontade do nosso Deus e Pai,

versos.grego: ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

controles.web: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
controles.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
controles.livre: ao qual seja a glória para todo o sempre, Amém!

versos.grego: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως ταχέως μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον,

controles.web: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;
controles.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
controles.livre: Admiro-me de que tão rapidamente desviastes daquele que vos chamou na graça de Cristo, em troca de outro evangelho.

versos.grego: ὃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλο· εἰ μή τινές εἰσιν οἱ ταράσσοντες ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλοντες μεταστρέψαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
controles.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
controles.livre: Não que haja outro evangelho ,porém há alguns que vos inquietam, e querem perverter o Evangelho de Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐὰν ἡμεῖς ἢ ἄγγελος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εὐαγγελίσηται ὑμῖν παρ’ ὃ εὐηγγελισάμεθα ὑμῖν, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.

controles.web: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
controles.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
controles.livre: Porém, ainda que nós mesmos, ou um anjo do céu vos anuncie outro evangelho além do que já vos anunciamos, maldito seja.

versos.grego: ὡς προειρήκαμεν, καὶ ἄρτι πάλιν λέγω, εἴ τις ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελίζεται παρ’ ὃ παρελάβετε, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.

controles.web: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
controles.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
controles.livre: Como já havíamos dito, volto também agora a dizer: se alguém vos anunciar outro evangelho além do que já recebestes, maldito seja.

versos.grego: Ἄρτι γὰρ ἀνθρώπους πείθω ἢ τὸν Θεόν; ἢ ζητῶ ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκειν; εἰ ἔτι ἀνθρώποις ἤρεσκον, Χριστοῦ δοῦλος οὐκ ἂν ἤμην.

controles.web: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
controles.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
controles.livre: Pois agora estou buscando a aprovação das pessoas, ou a de Deus? Ou procuro agradar a pessoas? Se ainda tentasse agradar a pessoas, eu não seria servo de Cristo.

versos.grego: γνωρίζω γὰρ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπ’ ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον·

controles.web: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
controles.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
controles.livre: Pois faço-vos saber, irmãos, que o Evangelho anunciado por mim não se baseia em pessoas;

versos.grego: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐγὼ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου παρέλαβον αὐτό οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην, ἀλλὰ δι’ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: pois não o recebi, nem aprendi de ser humano algum, mas sim pela revelação de Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Ἠκούσατε γὰρ τὴν ἐμὴν ἀναστροφήν ποτε ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ, ὅτι καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν,

controles.web: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.
controles.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
controles.livre: Pois já ouvistes da minha conduta no judaísmo, como em excesso eu perseguia e tentava destruir a Igreja de Deus;

versos.grego: καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου, περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων.

controles.web: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
controles.kjv: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
controles.livre: e como no judaísmo eu era mais avançado que muitos de minha idade em minha nação, e era extremamente zeloso das tradições de meus pais.

versos.grego: Ὅτε δὲ εὐδόκησεν ὁ ἀφορίσας με ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου καὶ καλέσας διὰ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ

controles.web: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,
controles.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
controles.livre: Mas quando aquele  que me separou desde o ventre da minha mãe, e por sua graça me chamou , se agradou

versos.grego: ἀποκαλύψαι τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ, ἵνα εὐαγγελίζωμαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εὐθέως οὐ προσανεθέμην σαρκὶ καὶ αἵματι,

controles.web: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
controles.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
controles.livre: de revelar o seu Filho em mim, para eu evangelizar os gentios, de imediato, não fui pedir conselho com pessoa alguma;

versos.grego: οὐδὲ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα πρὸς τοὺς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἀποστόλους, ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθον εἰς Ἀραβίαν, καὶ πάλιν ὑπέστρεψα εἰς Δαμασκόν.

controles.web: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
controles.kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
controles.livre: nem subi a Jerusalém para os que já eram apóstolos antes de mim; em vez disso, parti para a Arábia, e voltei outra vez a Damasco.

versos.grego: Ἔπειτα μετὰ τρία ἔτη ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι Κηφᾶν, καὶ ἐπέμεινα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡμέρας δεκαπέντε·

controles.web: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
controles.kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
controles.livre: Então, depois de três anos, subi a Jerusalém para visitar Cefas,  e estive com ele por quinze dias.

versos.grego: ἕτερον δὲ τῶν ἀποστόλων οὐκ εἶδον, εἰ μὴ Ἰάκωβον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.
controles.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
controles.livre: E vi nenhum outro dos apóstolos, a não ser Tiago, o irmão do Senhor.

versos.grego: ἃ δὲ γράφω ὑμῖν, ἰδοὺ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι.

controles.web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
controles.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
controles.livre: Ora, das coisas que vos escrevo, eis que, diante de Deus, não estou mentindo.

versos.grego: ἔπειτα ἦλθον εἰς τὰ κλίματα τῆς Συρίας καὶ τῆς Κιλικίας.

controles.web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
controles.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
controles.livre: Depois fui para as regiões da Síria e da Cilícia.

versos.grego: ἤμην δὲ ἀγνοούμενος τῷ προσώπῳ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Ἰουδαίας ταῖς ἐν Χριστῷ.

controles.web: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
controles.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:
controles.livre: Eu, porém, não era conhecido de rosto pelas igrejas da Judeia que estão em Cristo;

versos.grego: μόνον δὲ ἀκούοντες ἦσαν ὅτι Ὁ διώκων ἡμᾶς ποτε νῦν εὐαγγελίζεται τὴν πίστιν ἥν ποτε ἐπόρθει,

controles.web: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
controles.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
controles.livre: mas somente haviam ouvido que “Aquele que antes nos perseguia agora anuncia a fé que antes tentava destruir”.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐδόξαζον ἐν ἐμοὶ τὸν Θεόν.

controles.web: And they glorified God in me.
controles.kjv: And they glorified God in me.
controles.livre: E glorificavam a Deus por causa de mim.
